summary: Retire shell.ekodi.kr as an EKODI runtime and legacy-domain boundary and make https://ekodi.kr/shell the canonical shared Shell asset, manifest and UI integration path.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator previously directed EKODI to remove retired EKODI subdomains rather than preserve compatibility redirects and has instructed EKODI collaboration to continue this production completion work.
evidence: Messenger and shared user surfaces consume the canonical apex Shell path
deployment manifests and production verification no longer require shell.ekodi.kr
platform boundary registry declares ekodi.kr with canonicalPath /shell
shell.ekodi.kr is removed from the legacy-domain allowlist and target map
scaleImpact: None. This converges routing topology without creating a new deployment boundary.
authorityImpact: None. Existing human authority, authentication, authorization and service ownership remain unchanged.
rollback: Revert the v1.16.0 Shell canonical-path amendment and associated runtime/config changes through the guarded pipeline. Do not recreate shell.ekodi.kr as a compatibility redirect without a separate approved constitutional amendment.
